articles.summary: Las Piñas, Philippines (October 03, 2025) - TaskUs, Inc. (Nasdaq: TASK) is a leading provider of outsourced digital services and next-generation customer experience to the world’s most innovative companies, today announced the launch of its new site Hiraya in Las Piñas City.
articles.title: TaskUs Launches New Site “Hiraya” in Las Piñas further strengthening presence in the Philippines
